purpose: Pinned upstream GitHub learning sources for adapting proven agent patterns into AutoPilot agents.
status: sources pinned and reviewed at repository-metadata level; no upstream code copied or installed yet
budget_policy: No paid API by default. Local/offline mock tests required. Hardware and runtime costs must be checked before using local models.
import_policy: Do not blindly vendor whole repositories. Review license and dependency tree; adapt small examples with attribution. Run untrusted code only in an isolated sandbox. Pin commit SHAs; re-check upstream before upgrades.

immediate_plan: 1. Repair or diagnose existing offline CI failures before importing dependencies.
2. Prototype one read-only smolagents adapter using deterministic fake-model tests.
3. Benchmark it against the existing Python Earnings Hunter and Source Verifier on the same fixtures.
4. Reject the adapter if quality, security, runtime, dependency size or zero-budget requirements are worse.
5. Only then consider an optional pinned dependency; preserve native Python fallback and rollback.
